completion_definition: Completed means the initial curated cross-reference pass: the source verse and every listed target passage were read in the pinned Saints-Translation English records, and each retained pair has a specific explanation. It does not mean every possible biblical connection has been exhausted, or independent scholarly approval.

reading_notes: All 262 actual source units were read in exact native order before target curation, with complete text and original continuations preserved in the source gate. The current baseline and exact review plan were compared again before final construction.
All retained target passages and necessary context were actually read this run, with 139 ranges and 925 distinct native units preserved in the reading log. No prior-run reading credit was imported.

All 225 complete source/target/relationship/rationale triples were reread, including an explicit replacement read of the six elided first-batch triples. All nine final amended complete triples and all 49 deferrals plus three complete unretained cases were then reread.
Native gaps, compound labels, titles, dates, measurements, names and wording were preserved. Kings and Chronicles parallels explicitly retain differences rather than harmonizing them.
This is an initial curated pass, not an exhaustive search. Deferrals and unretained candidates receive zero completion credit. No production repository writes were performed.

notes: All 157 actual native units were read in order after both prerequisite gates; absent 1:14 was not invented.
Six sources have a second retained target for a distinct facet; no extra credit is assigned to the 18 deferrals, 8 read/unretained candidates or 3 unread Revelation hints.

All 86 context ranges and 709 distinct actual units are recorded with complete text. All 145 final complete triples were reread, including all 21 final amendments and the last two small precision edits.

findings.resolution: Final relationships accepted within their stated limits. Unsupported source units and read but unretained proposals remain pending with zero credit; no source wording is changed.

peer_review_receipts.evidence_only_rebinding: Author added nine context units already independently read and embedded in the peer log; TSV, cases and semantic acceptance unchanged.
